podcast.title: Rio PMP-300 Launch Support
podcast.body: As the best-known performer among those who supported the launch of the Diamond Rio PMP-300, Frank Black and the Catholics contributed a song to the 100 tracks bundled for Rio customers. "Frank Black and the Catholics, a song that helped launch the Rio PMP-300, the first portable MP3 player to go on sale in North America."
